source_domain: model.py BDNB dispatch and open_download only
analysis_receiving: bdnb receiving/CLI/Kestra source and source rosters

mutations.resume: Original controller same-ID resume preserves original action/body. Adapter strips only injected resume from its semantic hash.

download.name: bdnb- prefix; use exact files[].name returned by publication/pack

identities.entity_id: required operator-generated 32 lower hexadecimal characters, unique across all BDNB entity kinds within this Datasette operation
identities.entity_sha256: SHA256 of the complete immutable stored entity body, excluding only its own sha256 field
identities.row_id: 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA256 bound to original edition/table/source ordinal/full raw record or comparison finding
identities.replay: Same entity ID and exact normalized action/body returns the retained entity. Conflicting reuse fails. All entities immutable; decisions are new review entities with explicit supersedes_id.

commonEntity.title: string
commonEntity.files: array of {name,filename,bytes,sha256,content_type,...native manager binding}; empty before products

descriptor.title: required
descriptor.source_url: required original https public URL without embedded credentials; stable query parameters retained
descriptor.millesime: required actual selected publisher edition, e.g. 2026-02.a
descriptor.structure_version: required selected dictionary version, e.g. v0.7.11

scope.description: required source coverage and extraction description

tables.table: one of five dictionary table names
tables.path: absolute existing regular CSV file selected by operator
null_values: explicit source strings treated as null; original strings remain

descriptor.dictionary: optional complete stellar-forge.bdnb-dictionary.v1 object; all five source-backed table definitions, actual field constraints, source URLs and publisher_structure matching structure_version

rules: batiment_groupe is required; other core tables are optional and absence is reported explicitly.
Each table appears once; full CSV headers, all columns, all rows, original bytes and source row order are retained.
Imported whole files and projected row versions are immutable. Invalid cells/keys and duplicate keys stay visible as findings; absence of a required key prevents authoritative matching.
CSV raw cells remain original strings, including empty and zero. Declared typed projection is separate. Exact integers/decimals remain text, never binary float.

Original file is streamed, hash-verified and retained in the existing Analysis document store as ordered <=16MiB binary segments if needed; its whole identity and segment order are recorded. Original workspace archives carry those documents and database versions.

The bundled publisher v0.7.11 dictionary is used only when structure_version matches. Other selected versions require their complete explicitly supplied dictionary; primary-key changes require a separately reviewed adapter edition.
All three lists are explicit; empty means no restriction for that dimension; nonempty dimensions combine by intersection.
Groups are selected from original group rows. All address associations for those groups remain; addresses are selected through those associations.
Original source edition stays complete. Selection is an immutable complete original DatasetDatabase version set, not an editable source.
Selection keeps absent table, orphan link and invalid projection findings explicit.

body.title: required
passage_edition_ids: 0 or more imported edition IDs containing passage tables
body.fields: null for union of all actual group fields, or explicit nonempty array of field names
body.edition_path: required for chain: array of exact millesime labels, first=before, last=after, unique; optional for direct and then exactly [before,after]

rules: Before and after must use different actual millesime labels; no automatic nearest edition substitution.
Same-ID matches are explicit identity continuity unless contradicted by selected passage evidence.

Direct uses the exact before→after interval. Chain uses the explicit edition_path in order and selected passage rows. Same-ID carry across an unchanged interval requires original group presence in both adjacent complete editions and no selected outgoing change. Intermediate edition presence comes from the explicitly selected passage_edition_ids. Missing presence is unresolved.
Creation/deletion require selected publisher creation/suppression evidence. Unmatched rows without that evidence are scope-entry/scope-exit or unresolved, never silently created/deleted.
Fusion/division/transformation complexe are grouped correspondences; do not fabricate pairwise equivalence or average numerical values.
All group values are compared using type-aware exact normalized tokens. Null, invalid, missing-column, empty text, numeric zero remain distinct.
Address association changes retain every link; address-denominator weights are neither normalized per group nor used to prorate group measures.
Each comparison row has a stable evidence_sha256 used by reviews.
Address attribute changes are compared independently of the complete group/address link register. The fields option limits group field comparisons only.

body.author: required supplied recorder
body.supersedes_id: null or exact current prior review ID

rules: This records an operator review; it does not grant customer approval or alter original publisher rows.
Supersedes must identify the sole current tip for this comparison/item/evidence. New unpublished reviews validate current tips under original mutex; exact already published replay is adopted first.
Changed inputs yield a different comparison/evidence identity and require their own new review. Historical decisions remain.
Build complete original Analysis queries/report/workbook and full JSONL/CSV annexes using native streaming jobs.
Reports distinguish bounded rendered detail from full annex rows. No silent 100,000-row truncation.
Publication binds exact entity and current review set by hash; subsequent review changes require a new publication ID.
Return original file receipts in entity.files.
Use original Analysis workspace archive engine with complete original documents, immutable data versions, reports/workbooks/query exports and current database history.
Retain and return whole native archive descriptor and original job ID. No second database or archive engine.

result.limit: requested row count; a page may stop earlier at complete-row 8MiB payload bound, with exact next_offset
result.rows: complete row objects; never summary substitutions

source.typed: full header -> {type, state:'value|null|invalid|missing', value:exact string|boolean|null, raw:string, unit:null|string}

comparison.before: array of full source row identities plus raw/typed rows
comparison.after: array of full source row identities plus raw/typed rows
comparison.correspondence: {mode,edition_path,edges:[full selected original passage rows],continuity:[original presence evidence for unchanged intervals],findings:[]}
comparison.review: latest complete current review entity with top-level id and history_ids, or null; review_ids and review_conflicts are adjacent full identity arrays

collections.selection: five actual present table names, each original order; comparison-ready subset
collections.publication: original entity's data references plus product receipts

adapter.stream_rows: context manager stream_rows(entity_id,collection) yields complete decoded rows from one original read transaction
adapter.raw_collection: collection(entity_id,collection) -> native version receipt, immutable table and columns
adapter.begin: begin(kind,id,body,title) -> (retained entity or None, normalized input/intent); exact request replay
adapter.current_reviews: current_reviews(comparison_id) -> complete review entities plus exact review-set SHA
adapter.retain_descriptor: original standard response documents retain all original source segments; no added archive extension needed

sourceSemantics.geometry: Original publisher Lambert-93/EPSG:2154 coordinates; no silent conversion to longitude/latitude. contains_fictive_geom_groupe labels generated geometry. Opaque/invalid geometries stay visible as original source records.
sourceSemantics.weights: poids_s_* and poids_nb_loc_* denominators are address totals across all served groups, not totals across the selected group's addresses. Preserve raw exact values and publisher meaning.
sourceSemantics.scope: Source descriptor coverage and selected territory define observation scope. Missing crosswalk rows do not prove creation/deletion; unchanged identifiers normally do not appear in the passage table.
sourceSemantics.operatingContext: Kestra Ntico case study documents S3 ingestion and Docker/custom logic; deployed namespace, bucket, credentials and plugin/version must be operator supplied.
